newsitem.title: CHINA: China arrests woman for poisoning 32 neighbours.
newsitem.headline: China arrests woman for poisoning 32 neighbours.

text.p: A Chinese woman has been arrested for killing five neighbours by lacing their food with rat poison after a village dispute, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Wednesday.
Altogether 32 people had been poisoned in the village in central Hunan province, the newspaper said, adding that two had gone mad and 14 were still in hospital.
The woman had admitted adding the poison to her neighbours' food five times since last August, it said. It gave no details of the nature of the dispute.
The local court was currently hearing the case, it added.
